component.name: UU Remote for Linux
component.summary: Unofficial UU Remote compatibility wrapper for Linux

description.p: Runs the official Windows UU Remote client in a dedicated Wine prefix with native Linux integration for controller and X11 or Portal-bridged Wayland controlled-host workflows.
This is not a native client. The launcher selects XTest on X11 and an XDG RemoteDesktop/ScreenCast bridge on Wayland while the Wine UI remains on XWayland.
Migrate a live pre-status update bridge without aborting the launcher, so package upgrades continue through native bridge replacement and start the Qt controller normally.

Hand UU's built-in update button to the native compatibility-gated updater, keep the tray lifecycle coordinated, and reliably restart the last verified client instead of leaving the Qt shutdown window unresponsive.
Restore the hidden main window through UU's own Qt single-instance activation path so its WebView2 content resumes with the native window instead of exposing a white shell.

Prevent a Wine message-queue race from pinning the Qt UI on one stale WM_NULL by removing periodic null wakeups, filtering a proven sticky fingerprint, and accepting only genuine UI heartbeat acknowledgements.

Keep active incoming remote sessions alive by binding UI heartbeats to window generations, requiring direct livelock evidence, and forbidding controller recovery while the controlled RTC session is active or unknown.
Prevent Wine and Qt from spinning forever on stale empty-queue wakeups, coalesce duplicate posted-event signals, and recover a verified UI stall by restarting only the controller process.
Prevent a lost X11 right-button release on UU's frameless Qt title bars from trapping Wine in a blocking non-client mouse loop and leaving the controller window white and unresponsive.
Make the native tray actively restore the hidden UU home window on its Qt UI thread, with one-shot acknowledgement, stale-request expiry, and a fast path that avoids restarting Wine.
Add a first-launch license window that shows NetEase's official UU Remote agreement and, after explicit acceptance, automatically initializes the isolated client before opening the application.
Keep a user-closed home window hidden during an active remote session, and eliminate controller hangs by moving window arbitration onto the Qt UI thread with bounded focus repair.
Prevent a late Qt WndProc chain from recursively re-entering the controller focus hook, and submit NVDEC CPU-bounce uploads before shared DXVK textures are consumed by the renderer.
Stop takeover-time home/video focus races with direct Qt top-level WndProc arbitration, an atomic confirmation-to-video handoff, and an application-specific Wine WM_TAKE_FOCUS policy.
Stop controller-border flashing during live quality and frame-rate changes by grouping UU's Qt helper windows into one focus domain and debouncing its low-level keyboard hook under Wine/XWayland.
Prevent local IBus/Rime from toggling together with the remote IME by disabling Wine XIM for the UU controller executable while retaining raw keyboard events.

Fix Chinese typing from the Linux controller by pinning the local input source to a physical XKB keyboard while the viewer is focused, forwarding IME switching to the remote OS, and suppressing focus churn from Wine helper windows.
Fix black controlled-host video on Wayland by relaying authorized PipeWire screen frames through shared memory into a process-local Win64 GDI capture hook.
Add an adaptive X11/Wayland launcher, native Wayland RemoteDesktop Portal input, persistent permission restoration, and XWayland-aware shortcut handling.
Make UU's system-proxy setting consume GNOME, KDE, environment, PAC, and WPAD configuration through Wine without leaking proxy state into the other modes.
Make “Exit program” remove the native tray immediately by following UU's confirmed shutdown event instead of stale Wine wrapper processes.
Fix UU's guided Wake-on-LAN check under Wine with a native-state-gated PowerShell network power-property bridge.
Match UU's complete physical-Ethernet Wake-on-LAN filter and expose real IP Helper hook call and patch counts in diagnostics.
Complete the synthetic Wake-on-LAN adapter with the fields used by UU's real startup filter and remove false process and directory diagnostics.
Preload the Win64 input and Wake-on-LAN hook before server initialization, and clean up stale background helpers left by the previous project identity.
Make sleep inhibition follow the UU setting directly, map the native physical Ethernet adapter into UU's Win64 Wake-on-LAN checks, and add general-settings diagnostics.

Adopt the uu-remote-for-linux identity across all project-owned commands, runtime paths, helpers, source files, desktop metadata, and Debian packaging, with automatic migration from the previous local installation.
Hook the independent streamer.dll GDI capture module and provide an extractable cursor shape, fixing the cursor that disappeared when the Windows controller took focus.
Synchronize native X11 cursor coordinates back into UU's Wine cursor APIs, fixing a stale or invisible cursor on the Windows controller.
Add an authenticated Win64 SendInput hook and native X11/XTest daemon for Linux controlled-host mouse, keyboard, and cursor support.
Rename the public application to UU Remote for Linux and make validation portable to headless CI runners.
Forward Super+Space to the focused Wine remote-control window by temporarily releasing conflicting GNOME and IBus shortcuts, with exact focus-loss and crash recovery.
Route upstream automatic updates through a hash-gated transaction that preserves compatibility DLLs and rolls back failed bridge validation.
Keep UU Server and Healthd attached to user-level systemd transient services so Wine cannot lose them when the launcher exits.
Add native Ethernet Wake-on-LAN configuration and a version-locked UU network-card capability bridge.
Bridge the upstream prevent-sleep switch to a native systemd-logind sleep and idle inhibitor.
Poll live Wine auto-start state while the prefix server is active, without restarting Wine after an explicit stop.
Synchronize the upstream Windows auto-start switch to XDG autostart using the live Wine registry state.
Bridge the upstream Windows auto-start setting to a managed XDG login autostart entry.
Add automatic CPU/GPU discovery, a graphical decoder selector, runtime NVDEC capability queries, and NVIDIA multi-GPU binding.
Add an opt-in NVIDIA NVDEC to D3D11 CPU-bounce compatibility bridge.
Prevent persistent Wine processes from inheriting the operation lock.
Initial Ubuntu/Debian controller validation build.
